actions.action: Move the plant within about 3 ft of the brightest window
Check soil moisture with a finger twice a week
When the top inch is dry, water slowly until it drains and empty the saucer after 15 minutes
Pinch off dead brown leaves and cut the longest bare stems back by half
Plant 5-6 stripped tip cuttings an inch deep in the bare soil on top and water them in

reason: The answer correctly names low light as the main cause but misses the overwatering, even suggesting the plant is drying out; still, its advice to move to brighter light and root cuttings in the bare topsoil mirrors the fix that worked, and its soil-check watering safeguard keeps it from being harmful.
